title: Exclude maximal resident-carrier fusions on the current P104 word (no new κ)
body:
On the frozen #6702 native word used by #6726, exclude all 631 eligible single-helper two-MOVE fusions across 2,387 maximal chronological systems. The relaxation permits arbitrarily many dyadic compensating ADDs into every coframed public/live-owned receiver and free repair of all final full-bank outputs. No necessary response system is solvable over F_65521; the proved reduction excludes exact dyadic rewrites in this fixed-source class.

The new coverage is the maximal legal fusion window and complete resident-response span, beyond small-compensator searches. A separately authored forward SSA reconstruction matches all 33,455 residence segments and independently checks 2,387 separating witnesses through 24,012 direct dot products. The historical #6453 control recovers exactly the two published #6529 patterns.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
#6702: edd6a37a9ff87b254fb7466184348d1432d0c8c0.
#6726: 435bbe91fb28cb1d7a569ca70c6c4e9eb302d486.
Control heads, exact word/SPEC hashes and retained ancestor pins are in SOURCES.json and ORIGINS.json.

Reproduce (CPython 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-distributed-carrier-recoding
```
Expected: PASS_P104_MAXIMAL_CARRIER_SPAN, PASS_INDEPENDENT_FORWARD_REVIEW and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed both implementations normally and with -O, seven algebra/source controls, three altered-inventory/target/witness controls, committed-byte/mode checks and publication-pin replay. The complete remote tree matches the tested tree. Current-source coverage is exhaustive: stop after all 2,387 systems, without random search. Review seed 27 only constructs explicit, deterministically checked witnesses. Historical search stops at the first success per interval; the independent review checks every historical cut.

No new κ or native word. This excludes one interval at a time with fixed held source and receiver schedules. New bases, paid carrier stops, additional deleted exports, coupled edits and arbitrary non-dyadic coefficients remain outside scope. No framework assumption or full supplier admission is discharged. Open construction questions are retained in the package.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separately authored AI review. Credit the authors of #6453, #6529, #6702 and #6726 and their preserved lineage/notices. Apache-2.0.
